decisions.question: Which terminal-reading surface carries the capture, and what loop shape satisfies the line-break, no-per-line-limit, and responsiveness requirements at once?
What are the submit, manual-newline, deletion, and cancellation gestures, and how is each detected once the terminal is in raw mode?
Where does the reader live, and what seam shape makes the capture unreachable from the launcher while keeping the command-level behaviors unit-testable?
How is captured input rendered so the developer sees what will be sent, without replaying control sequences and without the superlinear echo cost measured on one candidate path?
How are raw mode and paste mode entered, restored, and re-established across every exit path including signals and suspend/resume?
